about: One sound track per walk-out hype move (user 2026-11-11: "Walk-outs at Hype Man", then yes to ElevenLabs sounds for the hype moves, "lined up with each animation"; standing rule: any audio Claude makes is made with ElevenLabs and lined up with its animation). Each hype move (art/scripts/entrance_animations.py) gets one ElevenLabs Sound Effects take from its own prompt (its moves in order, no voice, as the user asked for the celebrations), then art/scripts/make_celebration_tracks.py (TRACKS_MANIFEST=this file, TRACKS_ROOT=D:/Powerlifting Roblox Extras/Sounds/Hype) puts each of the take's hits on its cue (seconds into the move). The finished tracks are uploaded; ids in EntranceConfig (hypeSoundtrack). Audio files stay outside the repo.

Belt.prompt: Powerlifting sound effects only, no voice, no music. A powerlifter at a powerlifting meet adjusts his thick lever powerlifting belt before a lift. 1.05 seconds: one sharp, crisp SNAP of the belt being flicked tight, like a whip crack on leather. 1.4 seconds: a second sharp belt SNAP. 2.0 seconds: one loud, crisp, chalky hand clap. Then quiet. 3 seconds

Flex.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.7 seconds both arms snap up into a flex: a quick double arm whoosh and a tight fabric stretch. A second of quiet tension with a faint fabric strain. At 2.2 seconds the arms shake out loose: three quick soft whooshes and a light shoe scuff on wood. Then quiet. Close and natural, 3.2 seconds

ChestSlap.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.5 seconds one loud, meaty open-palm slap on a muscular chest. At 0.8 seconds a second chest slap, even harder. At 1.25 seconds the arms swing down and out: a strong whoosh and one heavy boot stomp on the wooden platform. Then a short low rumble of the stage settling, then quiet. Close and natural, 3.2 seconds

NeckRoll.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. First a slow neck roll: soft fabric rustle and one small neck crack at about 0.8 seconds. At 1.9 seconds a crisp chalky hand clap, at 2.2 seconds a second clap, and at 2.45 seconds a sharp arm whoosh as he points forward. Then quiet. Close and natural, 3 seconds

OverheadClap.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.5 seconds both arms swing up fast: a rising whoosh. At 0.9 seconds one huge, loud, chalky hand clap overhead with a big burst of chalk powder puffing out. At 1.4 seconds both arms fling out wide: a strong double whoosh and a little powder settling. Then quiet. Close and natural, 3 seconds

WingsV.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.5 seconds both arms sweep out wide like wings: a broad, smooth whoosh and a fabric snap. A short quiet hold. At 1.6 seconds the arms whip up into a V: a fast rising double whoosh and a firm shoe stomp on the wooden platform. Then quiet. Close and natural, 3.2 seconds

TrapSlap.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.5 seconds both hands slap hard on top of the shoulders: a meaty double slap. At 0.8 seconds the same shoulder slap again, harder. At 1.4 seconds one loud, sharp, chalky hand clap. At 2 seconds the arms drop and swing out: a strong whoosh. Then quiet. Close and natural, 3 seconds

CrowdLift.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage lifting the crowd. At 0.75 seconds both arms sweep up from low to high: a big rising whoosh. At 1.5 seconds a second, bigger rising whoosh. At 2.05 seconds a sharp, quick whoosh and a fabric snap as one arm points forward hard. Then quiet. Close and natural, 3.2 seconds

ChalkRitual.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.35 seconds a hard slap on both thighs, at 0.6 seconds another thigh slap. At 1.1 seconds the arms swing across the chest: a fast whoosh. At 1.65 seconds one huge chalky clap overhead with a big burst of chalk powder. At 2.1 seconds the arms fling out wide: a strong whoosh. Then quiet. Close, natural, 3.4 seconds

WarCrouch.prompt: Sound effects only, no voice, no breathing, no music. A powerlifter on a wooden stage. At 0.5 seconds he drops into a low crouch: both shoes scuff and grip the wood, a low creak of the platform, a tense trembling fabric rustle. At 1.7 seconds he explodes up: one huge heavy stomp on the platform with a deep boom, and a big double whoosh as the arms fly up and out. Then the boom fades. Close and natural, 3.6 seconds
